lines.en: It circles along the edge of a floating island.

lines.zh: 掠过云影，留下一道微光
lines.en: It skims past cloud shadows, leaving a faint gleam.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻颤动，发出声响。
停在浮空岛的花上歇脚
lines.en: It rests on a flower of the floating isle.

lines.zh: 收起翅膀，随风轻轻摇晃
lines.en: Wings folded, it sways with the wind.

lines.zh: 十四只同族里，它最安静
lines.en: Of the fourteen kin, it is the quietest.
In the morning light its wings slowly warm.
I lift my head from your sword hilt to look.
Staring at you, ready to capture.

lines.zh: 翅膀快速振动，锁定目标。
它落在你的肩头，又飞开
lines.en: It lands on your shoulder, then flits away.
It circles twice above your head.
Its antennae point at you and tremble.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的手，怕你拍它
lines.en: It watches your hand, afraid you might swat it.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的花纹对着你张开
lines.en: The pattern on its wings opens toward you.
When you move, it retreats into the air.

lines.zh: 它落在你的剑柄上歇一歇
lines.en: It rests a moment on your sword hilt.

lines.zh: 它顺着上升气流停在你面前
lines.en: It rides an updraft and hovers before you.

lines.zh: 翅上的花纹被撕开一道。
lines.en: A tear runs through the pattern on my wing.

lines.zh: 翅膀受了伤，飞不起来了！
你被它的光芒吸引，但它已不再善良。
lines.en: Its light lures you, but it’s no longer kind.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀闪耀着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Its wings shimmer with eerie light.

lines.zh: 它的眼中透露出饥饿的光芒。
不要接近，它的触角有毒。
靠近它会让你变得奇怪。
它的声音如同远古的低语。
lines.en: Its sound is a whisper from the past.

lines.zh: 它的飞行方式令人不安。

lines.en: Its form distorts in the light.
Its cry sends shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵剧烈的冲击。
它的翅膀碎片划伤了你。
它的力量比你想象的强。
lines.en: Its strength is stronger than expected.
You try to avoid its path.

lines.zh: 它的飞行轨迹难以预测。
你几乎无法看清它的身影。
它的动作比风还要迅速。
lines.en: Its movements are faster than the wind.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在空中划出轨迹。
lines.en: Its wings trace paths in the air.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的粉，在光里发亮。
lines.en: The dust on my wings shines in the light.

lines.zh: 它在空中盘旋以吸引伴侣。
lines.en: It circles in the air to attract a partner.

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻接触对方。
它们在光中交织在一起。
它们互相舔舐对方的身体。
它们在空中共享一次飞行。
lines.en: They share a flight in the air.

lines.zh: 它们的结合在光中显现。
lines.en: Their union glows in the light.

lines.zh: 翅上的眼斑转过来盯你。
lines.en: The eyespot on my wing turns to watch you.

lines.zh: 它的声音在空气中回荡。
lines.en: Its sound echoes in the air.

lines.zh: 花心里有东西，我去拨一拨。
lines.en: Something lies in the flower heart; I will probe it.

lines.zh: 它的触角似乎在探测我。
lines.en: Its antennae seem to be probing me.

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻触碰我的皮肤。
lines.en: Its antennae gently touch my skin.

lines.zh: 它的位置被我捕捉到了。
我已经定位到它的位置。

lines.en: It scents nectar and flies straight for it.
It fixes on a freshly opened bloom.
It darts at a fleck of glowing dust.
It spots one of its kin and gives chase.

lines.zh: 选定了这丛花，不再乱飞
lines.en: It picks this patch of flowers and stops wandering.

lines.zh: 绕开蛛网，转向新的目标
lines.en: It skirts a web and turns to a new target.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的脚步追过去。
lines.en: I follow the trail of your steps.
It is locking on the target.
It seems to be observing me.
It is locking on my position.
It is about to attack my position.

lines.zh: 在花间穿来穿去，不肯走
lines.en: It weaves among the flowers, unwilling to leave.

lines.zh: 翅膀收拢，对准那朵花心
lines.en: Wings drawn in, it aims at the flower's heart.
It hovers, taking a long time to descend.
It loops round and round the flowerbed.
It skims the petals, edging closer.

lines.zh: 它的影子在你脸上晃来晃去
lines.en: Its shadow flickers across your face.
Its gaze rises and fixes on the canopy.

lines.zh: 在风里稳住身子，只等时机
lines.en: It steadies itself in the wind, waiting.
Painful screams tear through the night.
It waits in the darkness for prey.

lines.zh: 翅膀一拍，鳞粉扑了你一脸
lines.en: A wingbeat throws scales into your face.

lines.zh: 它撞上你的额头，嗡嗡作响
lines.en: It bumps your forehead with a buzz.

lines.zh: 细腿抓了一下你的手背
lines.en: Tiny legs rake the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 它擦过你的眼角，火辣辣的
lines.en: It grazes the corner of your eye, leaving a sting.

lines.zh: 它一头扎进你的头发里

lines.en: It drifts slowly in the dark.

lines.zh: 我停在草尖上，翅膀一开一合。
lines.en: I rest on a grass tip, wings opening and closing.
It flies by in the distance.

lines.zh: 它在夜晚的天空中翱翔。
lines.en: It soars in the night sky.

lines.zh: 浮岛的光一暗，它出现了
lines.en: The isle's light dims and it appears.
It rises fluttering from the flowerbed.

lines.zh: 一小片光斑落在你脚边
lines.en: A small patch of light lands at your feet.

lines.zh: 它顺着上升气流飘了上来
lines.en: It drifts up on the rising air.
A small butterfly slips out of a stone crack.

lines.zh: 风把它送上了这座浮岛
lines.en: The wind carries it onto this floating isle.

lines.zh: 暮色里，翅影先于它出现
lines.en: In the dusk, its wing-shadow comes first.
The flowers shiver and it flies out.

lines.zh: 翅膀被折断了，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Broken wings! — and the fire makes it worse.
The blast left my wings see-through.
